XMLDB.COMMENT: XMLDB file for the UCKK seed tool

FIELD.NAME: action
FIELD.COMMENT: Canonical action: seed, reset, validate, export_preset

FIELD.NAME: mode
FIELD.COMMENT: Canonical mode: apply, dry_run, report, rollback_plan

FIELD.NAME: status
FIELD.COMMENT: Run status: pending, running, completed, failed, cancelled, skipped, warning

FIELD.NAME: component
FIELD.COMMENT: Owning component

FIELD.NAME: source
FIELD.COMMENT: Execution source such as web_form, cli, scheduled_task, phpunit

FIELD.NAME: preset
FIELD.COMMENT: Primary preset id when a run targets one preset

FIELD.NAME: presets
FIELD.COMMENT: JSON list of preset ids included in this run

FIELD.NAME: components
FIELD.COMMENT: JSON list of UCKK components included in this run

FIELD.NAME: summary
FIELD.COMMENT: Human-readable run summary

FIELD.NAME: details
FIELD.COMMENT: Optional detailed run notes or serialized result

FIELD.NAME: created
FIELD.COMMENT: Created object count

FIELD.NAME: updated
FIELD.COMMENT: Updated object count

FIELD.NAME: skipped
FIELD.COMMENT: Skipped object count

FIELD.NAME: failed
FIELD.COMMENT: Failed object count

FIELD.NAME: warnings
FIELD.COMMENT: Warning count

FIELD.NAME: errors
FIELD.COMMENT: Error count

FIELD.NAME: userid
FIELD.COMMENT: Operator user id when available

FIELD.NAME: createdby
FIELD.COMMENT: Creator user id when available

FIELD.NAME: modifiedby
FIELD.COMMENT: Last modifier user id when available

FIELD.NAME: duration
FIELD.COMMENT: Run duration in seconds

FIELD.NAME: metadata
FIELD.COMMENT: JSON metadata for audit, options, environment and result context

TABLE.NAME: tool_uckkseed_log
TABLE.COMMENT: UCKK seed tool audit log entries

FIELD.NAME: runid
FIELD.COMMENT: Parent seed run id

FIELD.NAME: level
FIELD.COMMENT: Log level: info, success, warning, error, blocker

FIELD.NAME: message
FIELD.COMMENT: Human-readable log message

FIELD.NAME: action
FIELD.COMMENT: Action associated with this log entry

FIELD.NAME: mode
FIELD.COMMENT: Execution mode associated with this log entry

FIELD.NAME: status
FIELD.COMMENT: Step status if applicable

FIELD.NAME: component
FIELD.COMMENT: Component associated with this log entry

FIELD.NAME: preset
FIELD.COMMENT: Preset id associated with this log entry

FIELD.NAME: targettype
FIELD.COMMENT: Target type such as category, course, cohort, role, capability, competency, badge, report, template

FIELD.NAME: targetkey
FIELD.COMMENT: Stable preset key for the target object

FIELD.NAME: targetid
FIELD.COMMENT: Moodle database id of target object when available

FIELD.NAME: summary
FIELD.COMMENT: Optional concise step summary

FIELD.NAME: details
FIELD.COMMENT: Optional detailed step data

FIELD.NAME: userid
FIELD.COMMENT: Operator user id when available

FIELD.NAME: createdby
FIELD.COMMENT: Creator user id when available

FIELD.NAME: modifiedby
FIELD.COMMENT: Last modifier user id when available

FIELD.NAME: metadata
FIELD.COMMENT: JSON metadata for the logged seed step
